ownedCover.authorImageScope.en: Only this account can read this selected asset. This image is not a player grant or a publication receipt.
ownedCover.authorImageScope.zh-Hans: 仅此账号可读取这项所选素材。此图片不代表玩家访问许可或发布回执。

ownedCover.imageUnavailable.en: This exact image is unavailable. No other version or image URL will be substituted.
ownedCover.imageUnavailable.zh-Hans: 这张精确版本的图片暂不可用。不会改用其他版本或图片网址。

ownedCover.selectedNotice.en: This cover will be used for the next review. Images in the current release stay unchanged.
ownedCover.selectedNotice.zh-Hans: 此封面将用于下一次审核，当前发布版本的图片保持不变。

ownedCover.unconfigured.en: Choosing a cover isn't available right now.

ownedCover.scope.en: Choose a cover for a future reviewed release. Picking a photo stays local. Uploading and selecting are separate explicit actions; existing releases keep their original image.
ownedCover.scope.zh-Hans: 为后续经审核的发布版本选择封面。选图仅保留在本机，上传和应用选择均需分别确认；现有发布版本继续使用原图片。

ownedCover.stale.en: The saved cover selection belongs to an earlier content or ownership revision. Review an explicit replacement before applying it.
ownedCover.stale.zh-Hans: 已保存的封面选择属于较早的内容或权属版本。请审阅明确的替换选择后再应用。

ownedCover.savedUnavailable.en: The current cover bytes are unavailable. The saved selection has not been cleared.
ownedCover.savedUnavailable.zh-Hans: 当前封面图片暂不可用，已保存的选择没有被清除。

ownedCover.readSaved.zh-Hans: 读取已保存的封面图片

ownedCover.editBeforeChange.en: Resolve any pending review or release first. After submitting for review, keep editing and save a new version before changing the cover.
ownedCover.editBeforeChange.zh-Hans: 请先处理结果未明的审核或发布。提交审核后，需要继续编辑并保存新版本，才能更改封面。

ownedCover.localOnly.en: This preview uses only the selected, sanitized image on this device. It has not been uploaded.
ownedCover.localOnly.zh-Hans: 此预览仅使用本机所选且已净化的图片，尚未上传。

ownedCover.uploadUnknown.en: An earlier upload may not have finished, and we can't check its status. Choosing and uploading another image starts a new upload; the earlier one won't be retried automatically.
ownedCover.uploadUnknown.zh-Hans: 之前有一次上传可能未完成，且暂无法查询其状态。另选并上传图片会开始新的上传，不会自动重试之前的上传。

ownedCover.receiptUnstored.en: Your image was uploaded, but couldn't be saved on this device. Keep this screen open and try saving again before choosing the cover.
ownedCover.receiptUnstored.zh-Hans: 图片已上传，但未能保存到本机。请保持此页面打开，重试保存后再选择封面。

ownedCover.saveReceipt.zh-Hans: 保存已收到的素材回执

ownedCover.readUploaded.zh-Hans: 读取已检查的上传图片

ownedCover.verifiedBytes.en: These bytes were read through this account's exact asset reference and matched its SHA-256. This does not approve or publish the topic.
ownedCover.verifiedBytes.zh-Hans: 此图片通过该账号的精确素材引用读取，字节与其 SHA-256 一致。此步骤不代表主题审核通过或已发布。

ownedCover.selectionReceiptUnstored.en: Your cover choice was confirmed, but couldn't be saved on this device. Save it before continuing to review.
ownedCover.selectionReceiptUnstored.zh-Hans: 封面选择已确认，但未能保存到本机。请先保存，再继续审核。

ownedCover.saveSelectionReceipt.zh-Hans: 保存已收到的选择回执

ownedCover.selectionUnknown.en: The cover selection is unconfirmed. Its original request is saved. A different current revision does not prove it failed.
ownedCover.selectionUnknown.zh-Hans: 封面选择的结果尚未确认，原始请求已保存。当前版本发生变化并不能证明原请求失败。

ownedCover.retrySelection.zh-Hans: 按原请求重试封面选择

ownedCover.failed.en: The action could not be verified. Existing cover and submission records are retained.
ownedCover.failed.zh-Hans: 无法核实此次操作。现有封面和提交记录已保留。

ownedCover.unauthorized.en: Sign in again before reading or changing the cover.
ownedCover.unauthorized.zh-Hans: 请重新登录后再读取或更改封面。

ownedCover.confirmScope.en: Apply exactly this asset to the captured topic, content revision and CONTENT ownership record. This changes the next review input, not existing releases.
ownedCover.confirmScope.zh-Hans: 将这项精确素材应用到已捕获的主题、内容版本和 CONTENT 权属记录。此操作变更下一次审核的输入，已发布版本保持原样。

ownedCover.contentSlot.zh-Hans: 已捕获的 CONTENT 权属记录

ownedCover.currentRequired.en: Read current cover details before reviewing this image. No content or ownership revision has been inferred.
ownedCover.currentRequired.zh-Hans: 请先读取当前封面详情，再审阅这张图片。系统尚未推断任何内容版本或权属版本。

ownedCover.receiptBeforeCurrent.en: Save the received receipt on this device before reading current cover details.
ownedCover.receiptBeforeCurrent.zh-Hans: 请先在本机保存已收到的回执，再读取当前封面详情。
